De instructeur geeft goede heldere uitleg, prettig rijlessen. De communicatie is heel goed.

review_summary: Only one genuine substantive review could be read (telefoonboek.nl, 2022): a learner who switched from another school praised the instructor's clear explanations, honest feedback, good communication and confidence-building, and the focus on practising CBR exam routes. Beyond that single positive write-up the evidence is thin and conflicting: telefoonboek aggregates 7.7/10 over 6 ratings while Google shows just 2.8/5 over 11 reviews whose text is not exposed anywhere, so the overall picture cannot be trusted.
